column1: # M1 (corrected 28 Oct): a SELECTED segment / chip / tab / register = --ink fill + --page text (Day Three)
# M1: text on a gold fill = --on-gold (gold stays the one primary action)
# M2: an --ink fill takes --page text (the pair flips together)
# M3: --br-deep as text on paper = --ink; --page text on a --br-deep fill = --on-night
# M4: the --scrim control fills are sunk fills (corrects the table rows that read them as veils)
# M5: a danger fill = the one gold button naming the act (ruling C)
# M7: gold text on a gold wash = --gold-ink; page-2 text on page-2 = --ink; hover text on a wash = --ink

# extended P4 (M8 states), same methods: light gold as text on paper → --gold-ink (M7); Yumi colour as text → --ink-2 (Q4); --br-deep text on paper → --ink (M3); unselected control labels on page-3 → --ink (the 28 Oct label ruling); text on a gold fill → --on-gold (M1)
